title: Leads table and API
context_line: Team: CRM-1 Sales pipeline. Database: crm1_db. Backend services/crm1 on port 5101. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm1 (id crm1, title Sales, roles admin and sales). Our job: track sales leads, opportunities and quotes for dealers and direct customers.
build: Table leads (id LEAD-0001, name, phone, email, source = dealer/web/walk-in, product_interest, status = new/contacted/qualified/lost default new, score int default 0, sales_rep_id text (an EMP id), created_at). Endpoints in routes/leads.js: GET /api/leads (optional ?status=), GET /api/leads/:id, POST, PUT /:id, DELETE /:id. Validate: name required, source and status must be from the allowed lists. Seed 5 leads with a mix of sources and sales_rep_id from EMP-0001 to EMP-0004.
needed_by: CRM1-A2, A3, B1 (lead_id), CRM4-B4 (creates leads here), CRM5-B1 and CRM5-D1 (read leads).
done_when: table and 5 seed leads exist; all five endpoints work in Postman; no name returns 400.

title: Lead screens
context_line: Team: CRM-1 Sales pipeline. Database: crm1_db. Backend services/crm1 on port 5101. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm1 (id crm1, title Sales, roles admin and sales). Our job: track sales leads, opportunities and quotes for dealers and direct customers.
build: Pages /leads (table of name, source, status, score; status filter dropdown; "Add lead" form; edit form; delete button) and register them in modules/crm1/index.jsx. The "sales rep" field is a dropdown filled from ERP-6: api('erp6', '/api/employees?role_title=Sales Rep'). Status is a coloured badge.
depends_on: CRM1-A1 (WAIT, same person). ERP6-A1 (MOCK: until merged, use a hard-coded list of the 4 reps EMP-0001 to EMP-0004 in the page, then switch to the API call).
done_when: you can add, edit, delete and filter leads from the one app at /crm1/leads; the list refreshes after each change; the rep dropdown shows real ERP-6 employees once ERP6-A1 is merged.

title: Lead scoring and Hot leads
context_line: Team: CRM-1 Sales pipeline. Database: crm1_db. Backend services/crm1 on port 5101. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm1 (id crm1, title Sales, roles admin and sales). Our job: track sales leads, opportunities and quotes for dealers and direct customers.
build: On create and update calculate score: source dealer +30, web +20, walk-in +10; email present +10; phone present +10; product_interest filled +10 (maximum 100). Recalculate on every PUT. Add GET /api/leads/hot (score 60 or more); define this route before /:id. Show a "Hot" badge in the table.
done_when: new leads get a score automatically; editing a lead updates it; /api/leads/hot returns only 60+ leads; the badge shows in the UI.

title: Opportunities table and API
context_line: Team: CRM-1 Sales pipeline. Database: crm1_db. Backend services/crm1 on port 5101. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm1 (id crm1, title Sales, roles admin and sales). Our job: track sales leads, opportunities and quotes for dealers and direct customers.
build: Table opportunities (id OPP-0001, lead_id, customer_id nullable (a CUST id), title, expected_value numeric, stage = prospect/proposal/negotiation/won/lost default prospect, expected_close_date, sales_rep_id, created_at). CRUD plus PATCH /api/opportunities/:id/stage {stage}. lead_id must exist in leads (400 if not). 6 seed rows spread over the stages, lead_ids from the seed leads, customer_ids from CUST-0001 to CUST-0008.
needed_by: CRM1-B2, B3, C1 (opportunity_id), CRM5-B1, C1, C3 (read opportunities).
done_when: CRUD and the stage endpoint work; seed rows cover all stages; invalid stage returns 400.

title: Pipeline board
context_line: Team: CRM-1 Sales pipeline. Database: crm1_db. Backend services/crm1 on port 5101. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm1 (id crm1, title Sales, roles admin and sales). Our job: track sales leads, opportunities and quotes for dealers and direct customers.
build: Page /pipeline: 5 columns (one per stage). Each card shows title and ₹ value, with a "Move to next stage" button (no drag and drop). Total ₹ value at the top of each column.
done_when: cards appear in the right columns; clicking the button moves a card and updates the column totals.

title: Stage rules and summary
context_line: Team: CRM-1 Sales pipeline. Database: crm1_db. Backend services/crm1 on port 5101. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm1 (id crm1, title Sales, roles admin and sales). Our job: track sales leads, opportunities and quotes for dealers and direct customers.
build: A stage can only move one step forward (or to lost). Moving to won is allowed only if an accepted quote exists: query GET /api/quotes?opportunity_id=...&status=accepted from this same service (use callService('crm1', ...) with mock: 'quotes-accepted' until C1 is merged). Add GET /api/opportunities/summary (count and total value per stage) and show it above the board.
depends_on: CRM1-B1 (WAIT). CRM1-C1 (MOCK: use the mock file until the quotes API is merged).
done_when: skipping stages returns 400 with a clear message; won without an accepted quote is blocked; summary numbers match the board.

title: Quotes tables and API
context_line: Team: CRM-1 Sales pipeline. Database: crm1_db. Backend services/crm1 on port 5101. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm1 (id crm1, title Sales, roles admin and sales). Our job: track sales leads, opportunities and quotes for dealers and direct customers.
build: Tables quotes (id QUO-0001, opportunity_id, customer_id, dealer_id nullable (a DLR id), sales_rep_id, status = draft/sent/accepted/rejected default draft, discount_percent default 0, needs_approval boolean default false, approved boolean default false, rejection_reason text nullable, created_at) and quote_items (id, quote_id, sku, product_name, quantity, unit_price). POST /api/quotes accepts items in the same request (one transaction). GET /api/quotes/:id returns items plus subtotal, discount amount, GST 18% and total. GET /api/quotes supports ?opportunity_id=, ?status=, ?dealer_id=. Seed 4 quotes using SKU-0001 to SKU-0015 and customers CUST-0001 to CUST-0008.
depends_on: CRM1-B1 (MOCK: store opportunity_id as plain text and use OPP-0001 to OPP-0006 in seeds, no foreign key needed).
needed_by: CRM1-B3, C2, C3, D2, D3, CRM5-B1, B3.
done_when: you can create a quote with 3 items and GET shows the correct totals; the three filters work.

title: Quote builder screen
context_line: Team: CRM-1 Sales pipeline. Database: crm1_db. Backend services/crm1 on port 5101. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm1 (id crm1, title Sales, roles admin and sales). Our job: track sales leads, opportunities and quotes for dealers and direct customers.
build: Page /quotes/new: choose opportunity ID, add item rows (SKU dropdown, quantity, price filled automatically), discount % box, live totals (subtotal, discount, GST, total). Product list from ERP-1: api('erp1', '/api/products'). Page /quotes lists all quotes. Save as draft.
depends_on: CRM1-C1 (WAIT). ERP1-A1 (MOCK: until merged, use a local array of 3 products from the shared seed list).
done_when: totals update live as you type; saving creates a quote that appears in the list.

title: Discount rule, quote status and order handoff
context_line: Team: CRM-1 Sales pipeline. Database: crm1_db. Backend services/crm1 on port 5101. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm1 (id crm1, title Sales, roles admin and sales). Our job: track sales leads, opportunities and quotes for dealers and direct customers.
build: If discount_percent is above 5, set needs_approval = true and block moving to sent until approved = true (set by CRM1-D3). Add PATCH /api/quotes/:id/status (draft to sent, sent to accepted or rejected). When a quote becomes accepted: (1) POST to ERP-4 /api/sales-orders with {quote_id, customer_id, sales_rep_id, items:[{sku, product_name, quantity, unit_price}]}; (2) post a timeline event to CRM-3 /api/interactions/from-event {customer_id, type:'order', summary:'Quote QUO-xxxx accepted', source_team:'CRM-1'}. Both are side effects: wrap in try/catch and log failures; a 409 from ERP-4 (order already exists) is fine.
depends_on: CRM1-C1 (WAIT). CRM1-D3 (MOCK: until approvals exist, set approved=true by hand in the database to test). ERP4-A1 (MOCK: log the payload). CRM3-B3 (MOCK: log the payload).
done_when: a 10% discount quote cannot be sent without approval; accepting a quote creates an ERP-4 order (or logs the mock) and a timeline entry.

build: Table dealers (id DLR-0001, name, contact_person, phone, email, city, tier = gold/silver/bronze, credit_limit numeric, status = active/inactive default active). CRUD plus GET /api/dealers?q=&city=. Seed DLR-0001 to DLR-0005 as in the shared seed contract (tiers spread across gold, silver, bronze).
done_when: CRUD works; search by name or city works; 5 seed dealers across tiers.

title: Dealer screens
context_line: Team: CRM-1 Sales pipeline. Database: crm1_db. Backend services/crm1 on port 5101. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm1 (id crm1, title Sales, roles admin and sales). Our job: track sales leads, opportunities and quotes for dealers and direct customers.
build: Page /dealers (table, search box, city filter, add/edit form). Page /dealers/:id shows dealer details and that dealer's quotes via GET /api/quotes?dealer_id=....
depends_on: CRM1-D1 (WAIT). CRM1-C1 (MOCK: show an empty "No quotes yet" state until the quotes API exists).
done_when: you can manage dealers from the browser and see each dealer's quotes on its page.

title: Quote approval screen
context_line: Team: CRM-1 Sales pipeline. Database: crm1_db. Backend services/crm1 on port 5101. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm1 (id crm1, title Sales, roles admin and sales). Our job: track sales leads, opportunities and quotes for dealers and direct customers.
build: GET /api/approvals (quotes with needs_approval = true, approved = false and status draft), PATCH /api/quotes/:id/approve (sets approved = true) and /reject {reason} (stores rejection_reason). Both only for role admin ( requireRole('admin')). Page /approvals (route-level roles: ['admin']): table with approve and reject buttons. Show each dealer's tier next to the quote (gold up to 15% discount, silver 10%, bronze 5%) as a hint.
done_when: approving a quote lets CRM1-C3's flow send it; rejecting stores the reason and shows it on the quote; a non-admin gets 403.

title: Tickets table and API
context_line: Team: CRM-2 Support and warranty. Database: crm2_db. Backend services/crm2 on port 5102. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm2 (id crm2, title Support, roles admin and support). Our job: handle customer support tickets, warranty checks by serial number and product returns (RMA).
build: Table tickets (id TKT-0001, customer_id, customer_name, serial_number nullable, subject, description, priority = low/medium/high, status = open/in_progress/resolved/closed default open, assigned_to nullable (an EMP id of a service engineer), created_at, due_at, resolved_at). Endpoints: GET /api/tickets (filters ?status= ? priority= ?customer_id=), GET /:id, POST, PUT /:id, PATCH /api/tickets/:id/status. Setting resolved fills resolved_at. After a ticket is created, post a timeline event to CRM-3 /api/interactions/from-event {customer_id, type:'ticket', summary:'Ticket TKT-xxxx: <subject>', source_team:'CRM-2'} (side effect, try/ catch). 6 seed tickets using CUST-0001 to CUST-0008 and EMP-0005 to EMP-0007.
depends_on: CRM3-B3 (MOCK: log the payload until the endpoint exists).
needed_by: CRM2-A2, A3, C1 (ticket_id), D1, CRM5-A1, A3 (portal reads and creates tickets), CRM5-D1.
done_when: all endpoints work; 6 seed tickets; resolved fills resolved_at; a created ticket produces a timeline event (or the mock log).

title: Ticket screens

build: Page /tickets (table, status and priority filters, "New ticket" form) and /tickets/:id (details, status dropdown that saves). The "assigned to" field is a dropdown from ERP-6: api('erp6', '/api/employees?role_title=Service Engineer').
depends_on: CRM2-A1 (WAIT). ERP6-A1 (MOCK: hard-code EMP-0005 to EMP-0007 until merged).
done_when: you can create a ticket, filter the list and change status from the browser.

title: SLA timer and comments
context_line: Team: CRM-2 Support and warranty. Database: crm2_db. Backend services/crm2 on port 5102. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm2 (id crm2, title Support, roles admin and support). Our job: handle customer support tickets, warranty checks by serial number and product returns (RMA).
build: On create set due_at = created_at + 4 hours (high), 24 hours (medium), 72 hours (low). GET /api/tickets/overdue (past due and not resolved). In the UI show a red "Overdue" badge or "x h left". Table ticket_comments (id, ticket_id, author, text, created_at) with POST and GET /api/tickets/:id/comments, shown on the ticket page; the author is the logged-in user's name.
depends_on: CRM2-A1 (WAIT), CRM2-A2 (WAIT, for the ticket page).
done_when: due_at is set automatically; overdue tickets show a red badge; comments can be added and listed.

title: Warranty table and lookup API
context_line: Team: CRM-2 Support and warranty. Database: crm2_db. Backend services/crm2 on port 5102. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm2 (id crm2, title Support, roles admin and support). Our job: handle customer support tickets, warranty checks by serial number and product returns (RMA).
build: Table warranties (serial_number primary key, sku, product_name, customer_id, purchase_date, warranty_months default 12, created_at). GET /api/warranties, POST /api/warranties, GET /api/warranty/:serial returning the record plus expires_on and status (active/expired) calculated from today. Seed the 5 serials TV55-2611-0001 to 0005 as in the shared seed contract (0001 to 0003 active, 0004 and 0005 expired).

title: Warranty check screen
context_line: Team: CRM-2 Support and warranty. Database: crm2_db. Backend services/crm2 on port 5102. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm2 (id crm2, title Support, roles admin and support). Our job: handle customer support tickets, warranty checks by serial number and product returns (RMA).
build: Page /warranty: search box for serial number; result card (product, purchase date, expires on) with a green "In warranty" or red "Expired" badge; a "not found" message; below it, a list of all registered serials.

title: Sync warranties from dispatch
context_line: Team: CRM-2 Support and warranty. Database: crm2_db. Backend services/crm2 on port 5102. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm2 (id crm2, title Support, roles admin and support). Our job: handle customer support tickets, warranty checks by serial number and product returns (RMA).
build: POST /api/warranty/sync calls ERP-4 GET /api/dispatches (rows with serial_number, sku, customer_id, ship_date; mock: 'dispatches' with 5 rows), inserts serials not yet present using ship_date as purchase_date (product_name looked up by sku is optional, use sku if unknown), and returns how many were added. "Sync from dispatch" button on the screen.

CRUD plus PATCH /api/rmas/:id/decision {status, outcome}. Approving requires an outcome (else 400). Seed 3 RMAs.
depends_on: CRM2-A1 (MOCK: ticket_id is plain text, seed with TKT-0001 to TKT-0003).

done_when: you can request, approve and reject an RMA from the browser.

title: Warranty rule and return handoff
context_line: Team: CRM-2 Support and warranty. Database: crm2_db. Backend services/crm2 on port 5102. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm2 (id crm2, title Support, roles admin and support). Our job: handle customer support tickets, warranty checks by serial number and product returns (RMA).
build: An RMA can only be requested if the serial is in warranty (call this service's GET /api/warranty/:serial; expired returns 400 "Out of warranty"). When an RMA is approved with an outcome, POST to ERP-4 /api/returns/from-rma with {rma_id, serial_number, reason, outcome} (ERP-4 owns returns; ERP-4 then calls ERP-1 and ERP-5). Also post a timeline event to CRM-3 POST /api/interactions/from-event (type ticket, source_team CRM-2). Both are side effects: log failures. Status timeline (requested, approved, received, closed) on the detail page.
depends_on: CRM2-C1 (WAIT), CRM2-B1 (WAIT). ERP4-D1 (MOCK: log the payload until /api/returns/from-rma exists). CRM3-B3 (MOCK: log).
done_when: an expired serial is refused; approving creates an ERP-4 return (or logs the mock); the timeline highlights the current step.

done_when: all endpoints work; the 10 seed customers match the shared seed contract.

title: Validation rules
context_line: Team: CRM-3 Customer 360. Database: crm3_db. Backend services/crm3 on port 5103. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm3 (id crm3, title Customers, roles admin, sales and support). title: Duplicate detection and merge API
context_line: Team: CRM-3 Customer 360. Database: crm3_db. Backend services/crm3 on port 5103. Frontend module frontend/src/modules/crm3 (id crm3, title Customers, roles admin, sales and support). Our job: keep the single customer master (used by every other team) with contacts, history, segments and clean data.
build: GET /api/customers/duplicates returns groups sharing the same email or the same phone (the shared seed has 2 pairs: 0001/0009 and 0002/0010).
